# Joint sub-model 3 + 4 fit (deoxyosones + thiols)

*Generated by `scripts/generators/fit_joint_deoxyosone_thiol.py`; thiol prereg sec. 4. 521 rows on 72 pots; engine state: B60 + B58/B59b/B59a/B61 on; sub-model 1 switches off; inline coupling; round-2 arm B7ASS. Raw residual = predicted minus measured (dex), before any scale; 'after scale' subtracts each series' fitted calibration offset (absolute rows: none; 'free': the series' weighted mean; tau: its shrunk mean) and is what a done-test reads. A hold-out row of a scaled series takes the offset fitted on that series' fit rows; with none it is not scored.*
